title: additiveHelix
body:
## additiveHelix

Add material by sweeping a closed, Body-owned cross-section around an axis while advancing axially, optionally with radial growth. Choose it for a coil or a helical boss: start an empty Body or continue its current solid tip. Profile offset sets the radius; pitch and section size must leave one valid solid. This typed family is under qualification; a passing short coil does not qualify every long-coil or growth case.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Supply exactly the independent dimensions for the selected mode; a derived dimension cannot also be authored or driven.
- Self-intersection, invalid native solids, unresolved precision or exhausted resource limits refuse the request.

Native binding: `PartDesign::AdditiveHelix`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `profile` | one node | yes | `profile` |
| `axis` | one node | no | `axis` |
| `base` | one node | no | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | Choose which independent dimensions describe the helix: pitchHeight needs pitch and height; pitchTurns needs pitch and turns; heightTurns needs height and turns; heightTurnsGrowth needs height, turns and radial growth. Omit the other dimensions so the adaptor can derive them consistently. | `{"type":"enum","values":["pitchHeight","pitchTurns","heightTurns","heightTurnsGrowth"]}` | `"pitchHeight"` |
| `pitch` | Positive axial advance per complete revolution, in millimetres. Author or drive it only in pitchHeight or pitchTurns mode; height/turns derives it in the other modes. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | omitted |
| `height` | Axial extent in millimetres. It is independent in pitchHeight, heightTurns and heightTurnsGrowth, and derived in pitchTurns. Height must be positive except that growth mode admits a flat spiral; a zero-height multi-turn spiral needs nonzero radial growth. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":100000}` | omitted |
| `turns` | Positive number of revolutions, including fractional turns. Supply it in pitchTurns, heightTurns or heightTurnsGrowth; pitchHeight derives it from height/pitch. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":1000}` | omitted |
| `angle` | Signed cone angle in degrees for the first three modes. Radial growth per turn is pitch*tan(angle); zero makes a cylindrical helix. In heightTurnsGrowth mode keep authored angle zero because height, turns and growth determine the native angle. | `{"type":"number","minimum":-89,"maximum":89}` | `0` |
| `growth` | Signed radial change per revolution, in millimetres, supplied only in heightTurnsGrowth mode. Total radial change is growth*turns. Choose a sign and section offset that keep the native sweep valid; growth is not a uniform scaling factor. | `{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000}` | omitted |
| `axis` | Body-origin X, Y or Z axis about which the cross-section travels. An explicit same-Body datumAxis input replaces this default choice; this option does not move the profile. | `{"type":"enum","values":["X","Y","Z"]}` | `"Z"` |
| `leftHanded` | Select left-handed rather than right-handed screw winding. This changes handedness independently of the axial reversed setting. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
| `reversed` | Reverse the axial direction of the sweep from the profile position. This does not mirror the cross-section or replace the handedness choice. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
